decision_rule.cannot_check_if: any relation, rights, repository, tag/commit, dedup, transport, domain or lineage field is missing/ambiguous
forbidden_claims: source-frame readiness from search hits or versions
decision_rule.natural_pair_count: zero unless all frozen relation/rights/dedup/lineage and external natural-pair gates pass
decision_rule.positive_exact_bridge_if: every exact bridge gate passes for a frozen DOI/repository concept; a pass licenses only an exact publication-version transport candidate, not a natural pair

all_required: frozen JOSS DOI exposes exactly one labelled Software archive DOI
archive DOI resolves to one immutable version record distinct from or explicitly equal to its concept identity
JOSS DOI to archive DOI relation is explicit on the publication page
archive version record explicitly identifies the same repository concept as the labelled JOSS repository
archive metadata explicitly identifies a tag or commit and that relation resolves to the same immutable Git commit
exact archive version has explicit accepted software rights and the immutable commit exposes the accepted licence
V3/V5 publication, object/archive and repository dedup gates pass
V4 unique frozen domain assignment passes unchanged
no_inference_rules: matching version strings alone do not prove tag identity
matching archive and GitHub dates do not prove version relation
repository relation plus current latest release does not prove publication-version alignment
generic or missing rights are not hand-mapped
archive files or releases never multiply units

normalization_and_dedup.doi: lowercase; strip doi: and https://doi.org/ prefixes; preserve version DOI and concept DOI separately
normalization_and_dedup.repository: case-fold owner/repository and bind numeric repository id when available

separated_gates.author_lineage_independence: CANNOT_CHECK unless outcome-blind external adjudication proves it; noncollision of names/owners is not proof
separated_gates.natural_pair_adjudication: CANNOT_CHECK; public metadata contains no same-claim, one-coordinate intervention or material-resolvability decision
separated_gates.provider_family_disjointness: JOSS publication metadata plus GitHub/Zenodo archival services does not by itself prove independent content-provider replication; provider-family classification is reported separately from item overlap

datacite_doi_metadata.counting: discovery/relation evidence only; DataCite never creates a content-provider family
datacite_doi_metadata.purpose: bind exact version DOI, concept DOI, publisher/host, version, rights and related identifiers

github_public_api.activation: only for the one repository labelled by the frozen JOSS page
github_public_api.forbidden: do not substitute current latest release or scan all tags to find a match unless the archive metadata explicitly names the candidate tag/commit
github_public_api.purpose: resolve an archive-explicit tag/commit relation and exact licence at that immutable commit

joss_publication_page.accepted_archive_relation: exactly one link whose visible label is Software archive and whose href contains a DOI
joss_publication_page.accepted_repository_relation: exactly one labelled Software repository GitHub relation, compared with V4 identity
joss_publication_page.purpose: bind labelled Software archive relation and labelled Software repository relation for the frozen DOI

zenodo_public_record.activation: only when the exact JOSS archive DOI is a Zenodo DOI with a numeric record id
zenodo_public_record.counting: one archive DOI/repository concept at most; files and versions are evidence, never n
zenodo_public_record.purpose: bind source-native archived version DOI, concept DOI, files/checksums, rights, version and source/repository relations
